decisions.reason: Drops the body-part calque and turns 일직선으로 into natural English without losing the straight-back knockback.

decisions.replacement: Their plan to take me down was ambitious, but their feet were slow, and the net of sabers they spread from the front was full of gaps.

decisions.replacement: In a very brief instant, two daggers summoned from my Inventory sliced through the air.

decisions.reason: 단검 투척 is the technique name dagger throwing, and the question is cleaner without the dash.

The split outburst matches the two-clause snap of 던져 놓고 무슨 개소리냐.

The Korean trails off with ellipsis; an em dash marks interruption.

쌓여 and 노획한 are piled/looted spoils, not merely held/taken.

변상을…… trails off; keep the ellipsis.
태세 전환 is the sudden polite about-face, not a change of combat tactics.
Keeps 애새끼 consistent with H004 and the incredulous 소협은 무슨.

Keep singular 주먹 and charged at them; 이런 놈들 is bastards, not trash.
decisions.replacement: I clenched my fist and charged at them. I didn’t need martial arts to deal with bastards like these.

decisions.reason: 쳐 is thug-speak; Get him is more spoken than Attack.
피했다 is dodge, 정수리 is the crown, and 일권 must stay a single punch.
decisions.replacement: I dodged the curved saber chopping straight down at the crown of my head, then drove a single punch into the opening at his side.

decisions.reason: 쓰러지는 is simultaneous collapse, 달려들었다 is charge, 상대 is opponent; keep the System window in the merge.
decisions.replacement: Leaving him to collapse with a strangled groan, I charged at the next opponent. A System window above his head displayed Level 35.

decisions.reason: The Level 35 System window is absorbed into the repaired previous paragraph.
고수 is master, and the saber sweeping is stronger than the passive was swung.
Useless against is the natural English for 앞에서 무용지물 in a fight.
낮을 뿐 is factual, not might have been; fold in 결코 내 상대가 될 수 없다 without the hedge.
decisions.replacement: My level and internal energy were low, but my stats far surpassed those of a First Rate martial artist. Add the combat experience I had built up in Murim, and this man was no match for me.

decisions.reason: The opponent line is already absorbed into the repaired previous paragraph.
Grip and finish his swing are more natural than grasp/complete for a dropped saber.
반쯤 넋이 나갔다 is a state, not merely looked half out of his mind.
조장 is the glossary term Captain, even when the bandit means his own leader.
통성명 is exchanging names, and 너는? is And you?, not What's your name?
들고 is raising the clenched fist; BASE omits that action.
Ask more politely is the spoken form of 부탁은 공손히 해야지.
The comma after Please keeps the overdone-politeness pause.
Actually did it better captures the incredulous 이걸 진짜 하네.
That politely and grant match 저렇게까지 and casual 들어줘야지 better than supposed I had to honor.
걸음을 멈추자 and 화색이 돈다 are stopping his steps and color returning, not a generic brightened.
착하게 살다 is live a good life; honest narrows 착하다.
The callback must keep good life, not switch to honest.
예? is a confused huh, not What?
Tighter spoken rhythm for 그렇게 쉽게 and 안 그러냐 without losing the meaning.
어느새 is before I knew it, the stealth beat already standing drops.
헉 is a gasp; Hic is a hiccup.
돌아봤지만 is turned around to look, not merely turned.
Keep 내리찍는 중 and render 정수리 as crown.
decisions.replacement: Hyuk Mujin was in the middle of bringing the wooden chair in his hands down on the crown of the man’s head with all his strength.

decisions.reason: Subject-first collapse with a heavy thud is cleaner word order.
고맙고, 미안하다 is clipped banmal; Thanks, and sorry matches that register.
그런 게 있습니다 is a vague evasion, not a claim that it's a long story.
The Korean is a declarative observation, not a rhetorical What's with that.
품을 뒤지던 is searching their clothes; old times' sake also spins 오랜만에.
조장님 is Captain, and something suspicious about these men is more natural.
뭐가? is the clipped What? not the expanded What about them?
인두로 지진 듯한 names a branding iron; BASE drops the iron.
Just a scar is the natural English for 단순한 흉터.
Keep SOL's syntax but restore 일종의; unmistakably drops that hedge.
decisions.replacement: Crude and savage as it was, it was definitely a kind of tattoo.

decisions.reason: 형태를 한 is shaped like a running horse, not the bare image.
이놈 하나 is this man, not this tattoo.
Checked them all is more natural than checked all of them.
Keep the fragment list and 조금씩; the same is a mild extra.
decisions.replacement: Arms, chests, necks. The locations differed slightly, but every one of them bore a horse tattoo.

decisions.reason: 단순한 is simple, 무심코 must stay, and 마음에 걸리다 is bothering rather than couldn't stop thinking.
decisions.replacement: I already knew they weren’t simple thugs. Two of them were First Rate masters, and the word the last man had let slip without meaning to kept bothering me.

decisions.reason: Glossary Captain plus the confirmatory 했었지; SOL drops the tag question.
Turning the thought fragment into a full question is natural English.
A sizable band... seemed more likely is tighter for 낭인 집단일 가능성이 크다.
문득 is suddenly; SOL omits it.
어디선가 is from somewhere; nearby alone locates the speaker too early.
큰 실수 is a great mistake, not one of his greatest mistakes.
나른하면서도 is languid yet alluring; the comma loses the contrast.
얼굴에 면사를 드리운 is a veil draped across her face, not a generic veiled woman.
우리 공자님 is the identifying our Young Master; my flattens that catchphrase.
The thought must echo the same our Young Master address.
Hardly did it justice and the whole-floor occupancy are cleaner for 말이 객실이지.
그것도 둘씩이나 is and two, no less; let alone is the wrong idiom.
Fronting the soft light is more elegant without changing 물든 미소.
Very definition is the idiomatic English for 팜므파탈이 따로 없다.
속이 울렁거리다 is queasy churn, not romantic flutter; keep Mujin in this one Korean sentence.
decisions.replacement: Even after meeting her several times, the sight of her was enough to make my stomach churn. Hyuk Mujin was beyond saving.

decisions.reason: Hyuk Mujin was beyond saving is already in the repaired previous sentence.
Restores the 사, 삼생 stutter and the set phrase honor of three lifetimes, not beyond.
Glazed is the idiomatic lovestruck rendering of 눈 풀린.
싱긋 is neither a bright smile nor a flashed one.
decisions.replacement: Wolhwa gave him a smile, then turned her gaze toward me.

decisions.reason: Perhaps matches the wondering 으려나 better than I suppose.
The mischievous-expression beat is merged into the following paragraph.
The merge keeps 짓궂은 표정 and the hurried wave in cleaner prose.
예전처럼 is like before, not same as before.
Restore 어머; 약관에 is such a young age, not merely at your age.
decisions.replacement: “Oh my, why? Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi sounds wonderful. If you’ve earned that much martial fame at such a young age, you could stand to be a little prouder.”

decisions.reason: 오십보백보 is the six-of-one idiom, not an added equally terrible.
곰방대를 물었다 is putting the pipe to her lips, not merely raising it.

decisions.replacement: I cut him off sharply and glanced at Wolhwa, signaling for her to play along.

decisions.reason: Quick on the uptake is exact for 눈치 빠르게.
알아듣긴 개뿔이 denies understood, not a vague she did.
Then again matches 하긴, and the open-then-hide logic is cleaner.
반신반의 is half-convinced, not merely uncertain whether to believe.

소문으로만 듣던 is only heard in rumors, not famous, and 였다니 is was.
듣는 입장에서는 기분이 별로 is unpleasant to hear; from the other side is translationese.

정색하는 is turning serious, not a generic change of expression.
왜 그래 is what's with you, not the stronger gotten into you.
조장 is Captain, and the rest stays within 소홀히 대할 수는 없는 법 / 좌시할 수 없어.
Matches the honor of three lifetimes wording restored in H093.
억 belongs in the interrupted speech, and the indignant 어찌 fits how dare here.
입을 열었다 before the next spoken line is body-part translationese.
The 예? 뭐요? double take lands more cleanly as what? What did you say?
이번 is the recent war, and amount of help is padding on 결정적인 도움.
Fell silent, then bowed is cleaner for 잠시 침묵하던 … 고개를 숙였다.
사죄드리겠…… trails off; keep the ellipsis.
실소 is a slight laugh; amused adds an unsupported emotion.
Keeps the squid proverb and 다 시키는 as all by himself in cleaner English.
얼굴도 제대로 못 쳐다보겠다 includes even.

공자가 사과할 건 아니죠 is you're not the one who should apologize, not you have nothing to apologize for.
시원시원하게 is letting it slide without a fuss; SOL drops that manner.
입을 열었다 is spoke, not speaking again.
목적 is purpose, not a reduced why.
산서성 is Shanxi Province in the glossary.
